text:
maria: FYI — I'm seeing missing NAT GW egress metrics in eu-west-1 which seems to correlate with KMS audit log gaps and a couple of GPU warm-pool nodes failing to finish init. nodes stuck in PENDING for ~6m. tagging this to eng-platform + security.

sam: ugh. are the flow logs arriving to the audit bucket? can you paste the cw query / sample log?

maria: quick CloudWatch Insights I ran (trimmed):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter resourceType = 'NATGateway' and region = 'eu-west-1'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
```
results are empty for the last 12h. only have sporadic entries earlier today.

jia: ops-bot reported a warmpool fallback earlier: 
"autoscaler: warm-pool-request failed -> falling back to on-demand; reason: egress-timeout"
logs show `KMS decrypt` attempts timing out while nodes pulled bootstrap artifacts.

ops-bot: action: autoscaler.fallback.triggered by warmpool-service at 2026-03-20T09:12:33Z.

maria: also ran `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-keystore` from a jump host and got intermittent socket timeouts.

security-jen: this smells like a VPC egress path (NAT) degradation + our S3 sink not receiving flow logs, which would trip our audit/alerting. can we confirm NACL/sg changes? anyone touched the nat subnet?

kevin: I rolled a small change to the VPC policy yesterday morning (tightened ephemeral outbound ports). I did not expect it to block 443 but may have limited ephemeral port range. rolling back now.

sam: while rollback happens, mitigations: 1) temporarily point warm-pool bootstrap to the region internal proxy (bypass NAT) 2) create short-lived NAT instance as emergency egress 3) enable additional CloudWatch agent on bootstrap AMI to push results to our logging endpoint over TLS. Which do we want first?

maria: temp NAT instance + proxy route would be fastest. I can spin up a t3.medium NAT instance and add route for the warmpool subnets.

security-jen: if we do a NAT instance, make sure VPC flow logs go to the audit bucket and we add an explicit IAM policy so the NAT instance role cannot assume privileged keys. Also increase S3 PutObject concurrency limit on the audit bucket to avoid dropped logs.

kevin: rollback of the NACL tweak is in progress (patch id: patch-2026-03-20-12). rolling back to previous ephemeral port range. ETA ~4m.

ops-bot: infra:route updated — added route table rtb-0a12 -> i-0b1e (temp-nat) for subnets subnet-warmpool-1..3.

maria: warmpool nodes started coming up after route change. KMS decrypt errors falling off. warmpool warmups succeeded for 3/4 nodes, last node still on second attempt.

sam: please capture the audit evidence for the change: CloudTrail entries, who applied patch, and timeline. Security will want a short RCA and remediation plan (NACL change needs a test plan).

security-jen: agreed. tagging this as security-sensitive. we'll open a compliance ticket and increase retention of flow logs for eu-west-1 to 90 days for now. note: cost impact estimate ~ $300-700/month depending on log volume — document it.

maria: notes for RCA: root cause = ephemeral port filtering in NACL change broke outbound ephemeral port range used by TLS connections to KMS/S3; impact = KMS decrypt timeouts -> warm-pool bootstrap fallback -> increased on-demand usage (cost hit). mitigation = rollback NACL + temp NAT instance + route fix. next steps = tighten deploy guardrails + e2e test for KMS/S3 egress flows.

kevin: sorry about the outage. will open PR with automated egress smoke tests and add a changelog reminder to run them before NACL edits.

sam: thanks team. please add the CloudWatch queries, CloudTrail IDs, and ops-bot logs to the compliance ticket (create when this thread closes). I'll draft the quick RCA and ping legal if needed. :thumbsup:
